result.rationale: Permanent Power Company, LLC is CIM's current manager-level PortCo and the same entity formerly named WEPCO. Westlands Solar Park is the California site/master plan, while Aquamarine and related entities are underlying projects or SPVs. Merge both existing records into Permanent Power, preserve the 2014 development and 2021 Aquamarine operating history, and retain one active CIM platform with no third-party exit or signed pending ownership transaction through August 19, 2026.
